headline: Failed House resolution would have directed the President to pull U.S. forces out of fighting with designated terrorist groups in the Western Hemisphere.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used the War Powers Resolution to direct the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with any group the President has designated as a terrorist organization in the Western Hemisphere. The forces would have had to be removed unless Congress first passed a declaration of war or an authorization to use military force for that purpose. The House voted it down on December 17, 2025.

who_it_affects.how: Troops involved in hostilities with designated terrorist groups in the Western Hemisphere would have been withdrawn from that fighting unless Congress authorized it.
The President would have been directed to end these military actions without approval from Congress.
Congress would have needed to pass a declaration of war or a use-of-force authorization for these hostilities to continue.
